title: When Feature Representation Changes Local Explanations: A Controlled Comparison of SHAP and LIME under Numerical Discretization
abstract: arXiv:2611.21159v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local feature attributions are computed over a feature representation chosen by an upstream data-engineering step, yet they are read as statements about the underlying quantity. We ask how discretizing one continuous feature changes local KernelSHAP and LIME explanations when the classifier is held fixed, and whether the two explainers respond differently. A random forest is trained on UCI Adult and frozen; age is collapsed onto equi-width or quantile bin representatives (k in {3,5,10}) before the model receives it, and the same 120 held-out instances are explained in every condition across multiple seeds. We show analytically and numerically that for KernelSHAP this is exactly equivalent to explaining the unchanged model at the quantized instance against a quantized background, so the comparison is between two effective inputs rather than a pure explainer effect; for LIME no such equivalence holds. translated_title: 当特征表示改变局部解释时：数值离散化下SHAP与LIME的受控比较
translated_abstract: 局部特征归因是在由上游数据工程步骤所选定的特征表示上计算的，然而它们却被解读为关于底层物理量的陈述。我们探讨当分类器保持固定时，对一个连续特征进行离散化会如何改变局部KernelSHAP和LIME的解释，以及这两种解释器是否会有不同的响应。我们在UCI Adult数据集上训练一个随机森林并将其冻结；在模型接收数据之前，将age特征折叠为等宽或分位数分箱的代表值（k ∈ {3, 5, 10}），并在多种随机种子下的每种条件中对相同的120个留出实例进行解释。我们从分析上和数值上证明，对于KernelSHAP，这恰好等价于在量化实例上、以量化背景解释未改变的模型，因此这种比较是两个有效输入之间的比较，而非纯粹的解释器效应；对于LIME则不存在这种等价性。每次归因变化都与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过固定分类器、仅改变特征离散化方式的受控实验证明：KernelSHAP的归因变化恰好等价于用量化实例和量化背景解释原模型（即源于输入表示的变化而非解释器本身），而LIME不存在这种等价性，因此解释结果应结合上游特征工程来解读。
